# Laya PII Guard

Checks Excel, Word, CSV or pasted text for personal data - names, PPS numbers, dates of birth, contact details, Eircodes, bank and card numbers, member/policy numbers and health details - and removes it. Get a clean copy safe for any AI tool (with a private key to put real values back), an anonymised copy for sharing, or an answer about your data without exposing anyone.

**Who can use it:** everyone, on free Copilot Chat or the paid licence.

## What to upload

The file (Excel, Word, CSV) or paste the text. To restore later, the cleaned file plus its key file.

## What you get

A privacy summary of what was found and where; a clean copy (with tokens like PERSON_001) and a private key file, or an anonymised copy to share.

## Example

Upload a complaints export and choose 'clean copy'. You learn it has 340 member names, 212 phone numbers and some health details, and you get a clean copy to use with the other agents plus a key file to keep privately.

## Try saying

- *Check this file for personal data.*
- *Remove the personal data from this file so I can use it with AI, but let me put the real values back later.*
- *Make an anonymised copy of this file that I can share.*

## Tips

- Keep the key file private - it holds the real values. Never put it in a shared folder.
- For very sensitive files, use the Laya Excel Expert for SharePoint or the PII Scrubber on your PC, so the AI never sees the raw data.
- Glance at the report - unusual names or scanned images can be missed.
